text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after we've reached a break in our activities, we finally go on our trip of rest and relaxation.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wow, they've got carbonated water and natural mineral deposits… Japanese hot springs sure have a lot goin' on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I can smell the hot spring all the way from here. Hehe, I can't wait to jump in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew… The water felt great.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I like sharin' the big bath with everyone back at the dorm, but it's nice to get a long soak in alone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It warms you right down to the core.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh man, it's time for dinner already. Let's go, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This stuff tastes amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon is thrilled with the luxurious banquet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I wonder what they use to make this savory custard? I feel like the base is made from bonito… Or maybe it's kelp?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Then again, maybe there's somethin' special about the eggs they used. Dang it, how does this taste so good?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah… All right, time for a new challenge!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna nail this recipe once we're back home! You better look forward to tastin' it, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We cheerfully enjoy our meal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm stuffed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, care for a light walk now that we're all filled up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to take a walk to help the food digest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mmm, the breeze feels great! The air is crisp, the sky's beautiful, and everything is so peaceful.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Being here reminds me of home.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, those were the good ol' days. I used to go on walks with my family, just like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We walk down the rural road, the two of us gazing up at the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Teach?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You know, when I won that raffle, I kinda invited you here on a whim.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But looking back on it now, I made the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm not good with words, but…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm not really sure why I chose to invite you out of everyone. I mean, I have so many important friends in my life.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There's everyone in Miho Dormitory, and I owe Fuji Kiseki a lot. Oh, and there's Brian too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've spent as much time with them back at the academy as I have with you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So, I wonder why…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon turns her eyes heavenward as she searches for the right words.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: After taking that nice bath, having some delicious food, and standing here, staring happily up at the sky…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've realized that this view is wonderful only because you're here to see it with me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's vast, beautiful, and full of hope.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …It looks a lot like the one I saw with my family in the past.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ugh, listen to me bein' all cheesy and out of character! Fuji's corniness might be rubbing off on me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Let's head back before the cold gets to us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks a little red in the face as she walks off in a hurry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Hishi Amazon and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
